The `tokens` object below mirrors the shipped `@theme` block in src/app/globals.css character-for-character. That block — not this file, and not any plan.md — is the final authority for token values. source.acquisition_method: Character-for-character resync from the shipped src/app/globals.css @theme block (SPEC-DESIGN-004, 2026-09-07). No live design tool was consulted — see live_reverification.
source.value_provenance: Three-layer lineage, not a single-SPEC transcription. Base: SPEC-BRAND-001 (commit b1c2862) replaced the original Classical palette wholesale with the OUR grayscale palette — all 24 colors and all 3 shadows. First correction: SPEC-DESIGN-002 (commit 5b2881e) changed --color-neutral-600 to #6b6b6b for WCAG AA contrast, a deliberate deviation from SPEC-BRAND-001's retired-literal mandate. Second correction: card t51 switched the two font tokens to next/font CSS custom property references; the rendered typefaces are unchanged. No value in this file is invented, re-derived from the codebase, or rounded.

AC-DESIGN-014 was therefore "해당 없음(AC-DESIGN-013 경로)" per that SPEC's acceptance.md. The precondition is still false.

notes: --color-neutral-* differs from Tailwind's default neutral-* palette. Since SPEC-BRAND-001 these are the OUR grayscale ramp — pure neutral greys, no warm cast — and they shadow Tailwind's built-in neutral-* scale project-wide. Do not conflate by name.

Single mono accent system — --color-accent (+ -2, + 100-900 ramp) only. No danger/error color role exists. text-red-600/bg-red-600 usages in the current codebase have no Classical counterpart and are explicitly out of scope (spec.md §3).
Spacing scale is a non-integer 1.15x ratio (4.6 / 9.2 / 13.8 ...) — intentionally airy per the Classical readme. Do not round to integers.

The typography values above record the shipped literal, which since card t51 is a next/font CSS custom property reference (var(--font-heading-nf) / var(--font-body-nf)) emitted by layout.tsx's font-loader `variable` option. The RENDERED typefaces are unchanged: Cormorant Garamond for headings, Lora for body. t51 changed only the value-sourcing mechanism, never the typefaces themselves.
replacement_map_pointer: No replacement map applies to the current values. The Classical→current mapping recorded in SPEC-DESIGN-001 is a historical record of that SPEC's own migration and was superseded when SPEC-BRAND-001 replaced the palette wholesale. To confirm a current value, read the @theme block in src/app/globals.css directly; per-component consumer counts remain in components.json, which has not been resynced (out of scope for SPEC-DESIGN-004).
